metadata.title: Nasdaq Nears Flatline With Chip Stocks Rebounding

content.text:
2 min ago
Chip stocks were bouncing back, helping cushion some of the Nasdaq's losses.
The tech-heavy index pared losses in the first few minutes of trading. The Nasdaq was down 0.2% after opening 0.5% lower.
The PHLX Semiconductor Index was in the green, rising 0.6%. Memory chips were leading the charge with the Roundhill Memory ETF up 2.5%.
